custodianAssessment.localRegistry: The Prefeitura/IPLAN municipal GeoWeb and Cadastro Técnico Municipal are evidenced by official municipal announcements and service procedures. The municipal platform is the local custodian evidence, but its parcel API was not verified.
custodianAssessment.nationalOrStateAgency: Paraná Interativo is a state-level cartographic publication service. Its Ponta Grossa group exposes text, line, and raster layers, not a verified cadastral parcel polygon layer.
custodianAssessment.distinction: Municipal GeoWeb/CTM evidence is local-custodian evidence; the Paraná Interativo service is separate state cartographic infrastructure and is not treated as a cadastral parcel registry.
